channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Oprah Winfrey — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-23
item.description: “I don't believe in failure. It is not failure if you enjoyed the process.” — Oprah Winfrey

item.title: Carl Jung — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-22
item.description: “The word happy would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness.” — Carl Jung

item.title: Sophocles — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-21
item.description: “Wisdom is the supreme part of happiness.” — Sophocles

item.title: Friedrich Nietzsche — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-20
item.description: “What does not kill me makes me stronger.” — Friedrich Nietzsche

item.title: Matsuo Basho — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-19
item.description: “There is nothing you can see that is not a flower; there is nothing you can think that is not the moon.” — Matsuo Basho

item.title: Rabindranath Tagore — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-18
item.description: “If you shut the door to all errors, truth will be shut out.” — Rabindranath Tagore

item.title: Octavio Paz — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-17
item.description: “Solitude is the profoundest fact of the human condition. Man is the only being who knows he is alone.” — Octavio Paz

item.title: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-16
item.description: “What is the hardest of all? That which seems easiest for your eyes: to see what is lying before your eyes.” — Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
